value: The requirement of at least 100 frost-free days is wrong — cotton needs about 210 frost-free days
reasoning: Cotton is a long-duration kharif crop needing roughly 210 frost-free days together with high temperature, light to moderate rainfall or irrigation, well-drained soil and bright sunshine, so a hundred-day frost-free period is far too short.

value: The claim of low variation in annual temperature is incorrect — the coniferous belt has an extreme annual range
reasoning: The temperate coniferous or taiga belt lies deep within the continents, where bitterly cold winters give way to short mild summers and the annual temperature range is among the greatest on earth; the sparse undergrowth, short growing season and widely varying precipitation totals are all genuine features of the biome.

India's four major reef systems are the Gulf of Kachchh, the Gulf of Mannar, the Andaman and Nicobar islands and Lakshadweep; the Gulf of Cambay carries heavy silt from its rivers and has an enormous tidal range, so the water is too turbid for corals.

The rare but very large deflections of alpha particles by gold foil showed that an atom's positive charge and nearly all its mass are concentrated in a minute central core, which Rutherford named the nucleus.
